sources.title: MOTOMAN GP8
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Epson SCARA 裝配平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付扭矩平方積分表及兩種額定判斷。；教學連續限制 2.4 N·m，原循環通過、6 N·m 峰值循環失敗；峰值還須另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the torque-squared integral table and separate rating decisions.; At a teaching continuous limit of 2.4 N·m the original passes and the 6 N·m case fails; peak limits remain separate.
related.difference: 用雅可比行列式辨認伸直附近的運動學敏感性。
related.differenceEn: Use the Jacobian determinant to identify sensitivity near full extension.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 電流近似與扭矩成比例時，發熱近似隨 τ²；τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt)。；教學扭矩 2 N·m 持續 1 s、4 N·m 持續 0.5 s、1 N·m 持續 2 s。；τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m。
二連桿平面部分 detJ=L1L2 sinθ2；接近零表示某方向速度能力退化。；教學 L1=0.25 m、L2=0.20 m，θ2=90°。；detJ=0.25×0.20×sin90°=0.05 m²。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: When current is proportional to torque, heating scales approximately with τ²; τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt).; Teaching segments: 2 N·m for 1 s, 4 N·m for 0.5 s and 1 N·m for 2 s.; τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m.
For the two-link planar section, detJ=L1L2 sinθ2; near zero, velocity capability degenerates in one direction.; Teaching L1=0.25 m, L2=0.20 m and θ2=90°.; detJ=0.25×0.20×sin90°=0.05 m².
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DLR Justin 服務機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付扭矩平方積分表及兩種額定判斷。；教學連續限制 2.4 N·m，原循環通過、6 N·m 峰值循環失敗；峰值還須另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the torque-squared integral table and separate rating decisions.; At a teaching continuous limit of 2.4 N·m the original passes and the 6 N·m case fails; peak limits remain separate.
related.difference: 用彈簧阻尼模型分析柔順接觸，分離位置誤差與速度效應。
related.differenceEn: Analyze compliant contact with a spring-damper model, separating position and velocity effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 電流近似與扭矩成比例時，發熱近似隨 τ²；τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt)。；教學扭矩 2 N·m 持續 1 s、4 N·m 持續 0.5 s、1 N·m 持續 2 s。；τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m。
一維阻抗近似 F=kΔx+bv，彈簧項與阻尼項都須保留單位。；教學 k=100 N/m、Δx=0.010 m、b=5 N·s/m、v=0.020 m/s。；F=100×0.010+5×0.020=1.10 N。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: When current is proportional to torque, heating scales approximately with τ²; τrms=sqrt(Στ²t/Σt).; Teaching segments: 2 N·m for 1 s, 4 N·m for 0.5 s and 1 N·m for 2 s.; τrms=sqrt((4+8+2)/3.5)=2.0 N·m.
One-dimensional impedance approximation F=kΔx+bv retains spring and damping units.; Teaching k=100 N/m, Δx=0.010 m, b=5 N·s/m, v=0.020 m/s.; F=100×0.010+5×0.020=1.10 N.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
